title: Carrier Reception Feature Wall
description: A welcoming reception area with a warm timber-slat feature wall, illuminated Carrier branding, and an integrated split-type air-conditioning unit.

title: Residential and Light Commercial Gallery
description: A dramatic showroom gallery presenting Carrier residential and light-commercial cooling systems with illuminated product towers and architectural lighting.

title: Air-Conditioning Product Display
description: A bright, modern display wall featuring floor-standing, tower, and wall-mounted Carrier air-conditioning units with neatly integrated controls and accent lighting.

title: Aesthetica Hub Reception
description: A welcoming commercial reception with floral wallpaper, a custom dark counter, clear protective screens, and woven accent chairs.

title: China Bank Savings APDS Loan Center
description: A bank reception and service counter with clear protective partitions, integrated workstations, and an illuminated red China Bank Savings feature wall.

title: Warm Timber Office Workspace
description: A bright commercial office with warm timber wall panels, a dual-monitor workstation, upholstered visitor chairs, and a glass partition. Indoor greenery softens the clean lines and creates a welcoming setting for client consultations.

title: Mousehole Lounge and Bar
description: A vibrant lounge and bar with orange banquette seating, dramatic chandeliers, hanging greenery, and colorful accent lighting. An exposed ceiling and decorative wall art give the space a lively, eclectic atmosphere.

title: Modern Monochrome Cafe
description: A compact cafe with black-and-white finishes, green-accented chairs, and neatly arranged dining tables. Geometric pendant lights, white brick-textured walls, botanical artwork, and small plants create a fresh, inviting dining space.
